g.text: Conceptual pair with positive S_AB and positive upper-terminal voltage for T_m>T_ref. Dissimilar sensing metals join at T_m; both instrument connections
are isothermal at T_ref and use a common third metal. Cold-junction compensation is needed unless the reference temperature is known. Seebeck response is
